description: Korean shutdown allowance (휴업수당, 근로기준법 제46조 · 시행령 제26조) when the employer suspends work for its own reasons: at least 70% of average wage for the shutdown days; the ordinary wage may be paid instead when 70% of average wage exceeds it; wages paid for partial work during the period are deducted first; less is allowed only with Labor Relations Commission approval; not applicable under 5 employees (시행령 별표 1). Average daily wage = 3-month wages ÷ calendar days.

approvedReduction.description: The Labor Relations Commission approved a lower allowance

fivePlus.description: Workplace normally employs 5 or more people

paidDuringShutdown.description: Wages received for partial work during the shutdown (KRW)

threeMonthWages.description: Total wages for the 3 months before the shutdown (KRW)
